notes_zh: 📝 新增记事本(Quick Notes):标题旁多了个小按钮,点开是个独立的多页笔记本,跟客户任务完全不相关
📌 第一页固定叫 Quick Note,打开记事本永远先看到它;后面新建的页面自己起名、可改名可删除
🔍 记事本自带关键词搜索,按标题或内容过滤页面
🖊️ 编辑区支持加粗/下划线/删除线/字体颜色/项目符号,内容会跟着窗口宽度自动换行
💾 记事本内容也会一起打包进导出备份;导入旧备份(没有记事本数据)不会清空你现有的笔记
notes_en: 📝 New Quick Notes: a small button next to the title opens a standalone multi-page notebook, entirely separate from client tasks
📌 The first page is always "Quick Note" and is what you land on every time you open the notebook; pages you add after that can be named, renamed, and deleted freely
🔍 Built-in keyword search filters pages by title or content
🖊️ The editor supports bold/underline/strikethrough/text color/bullet lists, and wraps to fit whatever width the window is
💾 Notebook content is included in backup exports; importing an older backup (with no notebook data) leaves your existing notes untouched

notes_zh: 🔄 可以换负责人了!点任务上的负责人小标签(现在带个▾箭头),就能选人或直接新建一个
🔗 换人是整条任务链一起换:当前这一期 + 之后自动生成的每一期,全部跟着走——同事离职交接一次点完喵
📚 历史记录不改:归档里存的是当年实际是谁做的。但从归档恢复任务时会自动接手成链上现在的负责人,不会把活又塞回给离职的人
📝 Other(一次性任务)没有链,所以只改它自己
notes_en: 🔄 You can now reassign a task: click the assignee tag on any card (it has a ▾ now) to pick someone else, or create a new person on the spot
🔗 Reassigning moves the whole chain: the current period plus every future period it spawns — so a staff handover is one click per chain
📚 History stays honest: archive entries keep whoever actually did that period. Restoring one from the archive hands it to the chain's CURRENT assignee, not the person who left
📝 Other (one-off) tasks have no chain, so those reassign on their own

notes_zh: 🆕 新增 Misc (Annual) 任务类型:选好STP还是TPAR,再填财年就行,两者都归在同一个Misc分类下,可以一起折叠
📅 截止日各算各的:TPAR是财年结束那年的8月28,STP finalisation是7月14(查过ATO官方,STP不是8月28那个日子喵)
🚨 备份提醒升级:超过5天没备份的话,一打开就会弹一个大红WARNING窗口,带一键备份按钮(顶部黄条也一起从7天改成5天)
📌 这个警告会排在更新公告之后单独弹,免得你顺手当成patch note关掉喵
🐱 右下角住进了一只猫猫!打开时会动一遍然后静止,鼠标靠近会自动淡开不挡任务
notes_en: 🆕 New Misc (Annual) task type: pick STP or TPAR, enter the financial year, and both file under a single collapsible Misc section
📅 Separate due dates: TPAR is 28 August of the closing year, STP finalisation is 14 July (checked against the ATO — STP isn't the 28 Aug date)
🚨 Backup nagging upgraded: go 5+ days without a backup and you'll get a big red WARNING popup on open, with a one-click backup button (the yellow banner moved from 7 days to 5 too)
📌 It deliberately queues AFTER the patch notes so you can't dismiss it on autopilot thinking it's just the changelog
🐱 A cat has moved into the bottom-right corner! It plays once on open then rests, and fades away when your cursor comes near so it never blocks a task

notes_zh: 🆕 新增FBT Return任务类型:固定周期01 April到31 March,截止日自动算成第二年6月25号,完成后自动续下一财年
🔀 进行中列表加了排序切换:客户名/状态/关联客户三选一,能开工的任务永远排最前面这条大原则不变,只是组内排序方式可以自己选了
notes_en: 🆕 New FBT Return task type: fixed 1 April to 31 March period, due date auto-calculated as 25 June of the second year, auto-renews into the next FBT year on completion
🔀 Added a sort toggle to the active list: client name / status / linked client — actionable tasks still always float to the top, you just get to choose how each group is ordered within that

notes_zh: 📋 进行中列表现在自动排序:能开工的任务(含已过期)排最上面,还没到开始时间的排最下面,同一组内再按客户名字母排
🗂️ BAS/Return/Other三个分类现在可以折叠了,点分类标题就能收起/展开,任务多起来的时候更清爽
📜 更新公告改成了完整历史记录——就算你隔了好几个版本才打开,也能看到中间错过的全部更新内容,不只是最新一条
notes_en: 📋 The active list now auto-sorts: actionable tasks (including overdue) float to the top, not-yet-started ones sink to the bottom, and each group is alphabetised by client name
🗂️ BAS/Return/Other sections can now be collapsed — click the section header to fold it away, handy once the list gets long
📜 Update notes now show your FULL missed history — skip a few versions and you'll still see everything that changed, not just the latest entry

notes_zh: 🚨 重要修正:BAS四个季度的截止日之前全部写成28号,实际应该是 Jul-Sep→25 Nov / Oct-Dec→28 Feb / Jan-Mar→26 May / Apr-Jun→25 Aug
✨ 已建好的任务会自动跟着修正,不用手动改——包括进行中、历史记录、甚至你之前导出的旧备份文件,重新导入也会自动修好
notes_en: 🚨 Important fix: BAS due dates were all wrong (28th every quarter) — corrected to the real dates: Jul-Sep→25 Nov / Oct-Dec→28 Feb / Jan-Mar→26 May / Apr-Jun→25 Aug
✨ Existing tasks are automatically corrected, no manual fixing needed — this covers active tasks, archived history, and even old backup files if you re-import them

notes_zh: 🛡️ 数据保险箱:每次版本更新时,系统会在新代码碰你的数据之前自动存一份快照——就算未来某次更新翻车,也能一键回到更新前的状态喵
🐛 诚实修复:"立即更新"按钮改名"知道了"——你打开时其实已经是新版了,之前那个按钮属于装装样子😂
notes_en: 🛡️ Data vault: every version update now auto-snapshots your data BEFORE the new code touches it — if a future update ever breaks things, one click rolls you back
🐛 Honesty patch: "Update now" renamed to "Got it" — you're already on the new version when you open the page, so that button was pure theatre 😂

notes_zh: 🛠️ 系统升级:更新提醒终于装上了真的记忆——以后版本一变,你和同事都会准时收到这种弹窗喵
🐛 修复:导出备份万一失败也不会再把人卡在弹窗里出不去了
notes_en: 🛠️ Under the hood: update notifications now actually remember what you've seen — future bumps will reliably ping you and your teammates
🐛 Fixed: a failed backup export could no longer trap you inside the update popup

notes_zh: 🐛 修复:新增任务按钮点了没反应的问题(上个版本改BAS选择器时留下的漏网bug)
notes_en: 🐛 Fixed: the + (add task) button doing nothing on click, a leftover bug from the previous BAS picker rework

notes_zh: 🎯 新玩法:BAS建卡不用再看老天脸色——直接选Q几 + 填年份,想建哪年建哪年!
🌏 新人友好:同事第一次打开默认英文界面,不会被劝退喵
notes_en: 🎯 New: BAS task creation now lets you pick any quarter + year directly — no more waiting on the calendar!
🌏 QoL: First-time visitors now see English by default, so new teammates aren't dropped straight into Chinese

notes_zh: 🎉 首个发布版本
notes_en: 🎉 Initial release
